evals.prompt: I already did the analysis work, I just need you to put the brain into Kaneo so we can resume later. Use workspace `mcp-kaneo-test`, project `mcp-kaneo-test-project`, status `to-do`, priority `high`. Create a parent task plus 2-3 subtasks if that makes the handoff more executable. Context: We investigated a token refresh race in a web app. What we learned: the API client retries 401s, but if three requests fail at once they each start their own refresh call. The refresh endpoint invalidates the previous token immediately, so concurrent refreshes can knock each other out and leave the UI logged out. `AuthProvider` assumes refresh is idempotent, but it is not. `useCurrentUser` also treats any refresh error as a hard logout, which makes the failure noisy. Missing piece: there is no shared in-flight refresh promise. Constraints: backend behavior cannot change this sprint, so fix must be client-side. Recommended path: centralize refresh orchestration in the API client, fan out waiting callers to one promise, and only hard-logout after a confirmed refresh failure. Useful refs: `src/lib/apiClient.ts`, `src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx`, `src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts`. Verify commands: `pnpm test src/lib/apiClient.test.ts`, `pnpm test src/auth/AuthProvider.test.tsx`. Please preserve the reasoning, not code dumps.
evals.expected_output: A high-signal parent task that captures the race condition, constraints, recommended fix, references, and a few actionable subtasks without dumping source code.
